Subject: Multiparametric MRI of the Prostate
Facility: LUMC (Leiden)
Date: 10 Jan 2025
Clinical indication: Re-evaluation of prior prostate cancer diagnosis. Current PSA 4.7 ng/mL.
FINDINGS: Glandular volume registers at 56.0 mL. T2 sequences highlight a discrete hypointense focus within the right peripheral zone at mid-gland level, spanning roughly 18 mm. Diffusion-weighted acquisition shows pronounced restriction, mirrored by hypointensity on the ADC map. Dynamic contrast studies capture early, localized enhancement contrasting with adjacent parenchyma. Seminal vesicles remain clear. Extracapsular extension and suspicious pelvic lymphadenopathy are conspicuously absent. Bladder and rectal contours are intact.
IMPRESSION: PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right peripheral zone, mid-gland. Prostate volume 56.0 mL yielding a PSA density of 0.07 ng/mL/mL. csPCa predicted probability 0.78553134
